RuntimeModule.Name: DustbornsV9
RuntimeModule.Title: Dustborns - Quests, Technologies and Census of Ash
RuntimeModule.Description: Фикс: x0.5 пром через PlanetPopulationIndustry Percent, старт 2+1 безвольный через MajorPopulation Count и HomeImprovement. Пыль: +8 Teeming неистощена, +4 средняя неистощена. Безвольные без политики, +3/+6 инд, без науки/влияния.
RuntimeModule.Author: Arena Agent
RuntimeModule.ReleaseNotes: 1.16 - TECH EFFECTS FIX: all technology SimulationDescriptor modifiers now use Path="../ClassEmpire/..." (from Research object) - previously Path="ClassEmpire/..." silently failed, so techs showed text but had no effect (food-to-dust, digestion +300, depletion -0.1, shells +2 industry). T1 "First Hunger" is now a Chapter 1 quest reward (Action_UnlockTechnology) instead of a tree tech (Visibility=Hidden), alongside the 200 dust - food-to-dust no longer starts from turn 1 and only unlocks after completing Chapter 1. CONVERT TO BEZVOLNY: rewritten using the vanilla Horatio "Clone Major Population" pattern (PopulationSource="Minor", PopulationDestinationHeuristic="LowestCount", correct path ColonizedStarSystemStateColony/ClassColonizedPlanet/PopulationNonMajor, NotEnoughPopulation prerequisite) - the improvement now appears when minors share a planet with Dustborns. CENSUS OF WORLDS: added 16 hidden quest listeners (one per planet type) that apply DustbornCatalogPlanetEntry to the empire when a planet of that type is first fully depleted - dust harvest now grows 4/8 -> 6/12 -> 8/16... per unique depleted planet type. 1.15 - QUESTS DEPLETION: "deplete N planets" objectives (Chapter2-B, 3-A/B/C, 5-B) rewritten to the canonical Condition_IsProgressionComplete pattern with InterpretedVar Start/End counts (official ExampleSimpleQuests style) - the counter now advances per depleted planet, not per turn; added PlanetTypeAsh to the "hot" branch (3-B). FOOD TECH: added T1 technology TechnologyDustbornFoodToDust0 "First Hunger" (era 1, Economy and Trade) that UNLOCKS the food-to-dust mechanic (+25%); removed the built-in 25% from the population trait (conversion no longer works from turn 1); chain is now 0->1->2->3 with TechnologyLink 0-1 and -25% cost reduction; added GUI + localization. TOOLTIP: added %SystemGrowthTitle localization so the conversion tooltip no longer shows the raw key. 1.14 - QUESTS GUI: added QuestGuiElement (with ExtraType) - quests now display name/text/objective/reward; Prerequisites now use Target="$(Empire)" + PathPrerequisite EmpireTypeMajor/ClassPopulation,ClassPopulationEmpireAffinityDustborns,PopulationMajor (official ExampleSimpleQuests pattern); removed Chapter0 launcher (Chapter1 self-gated via Prerequisites, BeginTurn, MinimumTurn=3); ScholarShells is now a Solo quest with the same faction gate - no longer fires for all factions. TECH BRANCHES: technologies now require the previous one (TechnologyPrerequisite Flags="Prerequisite,Link,Disable"); added TechnologyLinkDefinitions (+DatabasePlugin) that draw the branch lines and give -25% cost (official ExampleTechnology pattern); custom cost formulas rebuilt correctly. 1.13 - TECH TREE: techs moved into real quadrants (Digestion=Empire Development, FoodToDust=Economy and Trade, Depletion/Shells=Science and Exploration) with correct stage/category/cost/count descriptors; vertical chains: FoodToDust1->2->3, Digestion1->2->3, Depletion1->Shells1. QUESTS: rewritten objectives to proven element names (Decorator_ConstructionCompleted+Input_ConstructionName, Condition_CheckInterpreter+Input_Context/Input_Expression); restored hidden Chapter0 launcher (MinimumTurn=3) as the faction gate; all quest filters now use ClassEmpire,AffinityMappingDustborns instead of the broken population-count path - main quest appears on turn 3 for Dustborns only, side quest ScholarShells no longer fires for all factions. 1.12 - TECH TREE: techs now use TechnologyGuiElement2 with X/Y (were invisible in the tree); added TechnologyGuiElement2 to GuiElement plugin ExtraTypes; added icons. FOOD: rewrote food-to-dust (v6): money = SystemGrowth*0.25 written directly to SystemMoney, DisableFoodConversion=1 stops food->industry; removed the SystemProductionFromGrowth hack that caused food->industry; techs add +25% each. QUESTS: removed redundant Chapter0 launcher (started Chapter1 on turn 1 over the game intro); added faction Prerequisites to all chapters. 1.11 - CRASH FIX: Droplists rewritten to correct ES2 format (Resource with Quantity, no DroppableStack); removed invalid ExtraType 'DroppableStack' from Dustborns.xml; added GuiElement/localization for tech category CategoryTechnologyFactionDustborns. 1.10 - Fixed half industry via PlanetPopulationIndustry Percent -0.5, added home improvement to spawn Bezvolny, Standard true for Bezvolny, removed politics, dust bonus via tags Meager/Teeming * BonusFromDepletion
